statement: G42's licence-free access to cutting-edge AI chips expires around April 2027 unless it becomes U.S.-headquartered or re-applies, and executives have held exploratory talks about selling a controlling stake to American firms.
why: A hard expiry date on a large Gulf buyer's chip authorization puts a dated question mark over a meaningful slice of non-U.S. accelerator demand.

impact.mechanism: If the authorization lapses without a U.S. ownership restructuring, G42 and Core42 lose licence-free purchasing and their planned accelerator orders stall or shift to licensed intermediaries.

evidence.excerpt: G42 can buy cutting-edge chips without a US licence only until around April 2027

confidence.basis: Secondary outlet citing Bloomberg reporting; the document states no decision has been made and G42 declined to comment.
